query: ComfyUI-GGUF 2.0.0 on Windows: GGUFModelPatcher.unpatch_model with unpatch_weights=True touches GGUF mmap'd raw tensor memory during cache cleanup → access-violation crash (regression from 2.0.0 refactor; 1.1.6 had the fix).

desired.outcome: OP gives definitive cause + one-line fix: pass unpatch_weights=False to super().unpatch_model(device_to, unpatch_weights=False) so the base patcher never touches mmap weight memory; model still unloads normally, no crash (OP-verified).
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
